evidence.title: Repomon owned controller and scheduler
evidence.locator: docs/desktop.md Repomind502–517; Standing orchestrations476–490; Git explorer584–590
evidence.finding: Starting Repomind creates a product-owned controller lane/home with memory, plans, playbooks and journal. Its UI can run standing duties on a daily/interval timer; unattended runs are documented with tighter caps and merge/delete refusal. The desktop Git explorer displays full file/commit patches.

evidence.title: Repomind shipped controller instructions
evidence.locator: crates/repomon-mcp/assets/repomind.md opening/fleet model and Operating loop lines 1–44
evidence.finding: The shipped controller prompt explicitly directs the Repomind role to create lanes, spawn workers, read/send to them, wait, inspect diffs and merge clean committed lanes through product MCP tools. This is documentation of a product-owned controller, not an instruction followed by this research session. It calls normal merge and conflict abort; it is not itself a proof of every enforcement check.
